name: wadejbeckett/bulk-catalogue-manager-for-woocommerce
description: Manage many WooCommerce products at once from one simple screen. Every bulk change is previewed first, recorded and reversible.

scripts-descriptions.make-pot: Regenerate languages/bulk-catalogue-manager-for-woocommerce.pot with wp i18n make-pot (wp-cli/i18n-command, a dev dependency; no WordPress install needed).
scripts-descriptions.make-json: Split the JavaScript strings of every languages/*.po into the per-script JSON files wp_set_script_translations() loads (languages/<slug>-<locale>-<md5 of assets/build/index.js>.json). Safe with no .po files: it creates nothing. The committed .pot is made with --no-location, so a bundled .po must carry '#: assets/build/index.js' references for make-json to map its strings; directory language packs come from translate.wordpress.org and need none of this.
scripts-descriptions.i18n: Regenerate every translation file: the .pot (make-pot), then the JavaScript JSON files (make-json).
scripts-descriptions.build-zip: Build and verify dist/<slug>-<version>.zip from HEAD (bin/build-zip.sh).
scripts-descriptions.plugin-check: Compare a Plugin Check JSON report with bin/plugin-check-allowed.tsv (bin/plugin-check.sh --help).
